risk_assessment.rationale: The use of an encoded PowerShell command with suspicious parent processes (such as C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe) and network connections to localhost suggests possible malicious intent, likely involving brute force attempts or data exfiltration. The high number of related events and the nature of the execution chain indicate a coordinated attack pattern.
